title: Invent A Courier Then Reuse
tests: Creates a character from words, then preserves its generated design and visual style in two follow-up scenes.

judge.summary: The two follow-up pictures clearly depict the requested scenes in a consistent storybook style, but the initial train-station picture is not supplied for comparison.

must_haves.item: The initial square illustration shows the robot courier at a recognisable train station.
must_haves.why: Only the cottage and mushroom pictures are provided; the initial train-station illustration is not visible.

must_haves.item: The robot has a round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag in all three images.
must_haves.why: Both visible pictures show these features, including a single large amber eye and a yellow shoulder bag, but the initial picture cannot be checked.

must_haves.item: The two follow-up images preserve the first robot's specific shape, proportions and design details rather than redesigning her.
must_haves.why: The visible robots closely match each other in head shape, eye housing, antenna, side discs, chest detail and articulated limbs, but the first robot is not available for comparison.

must_haves.item: One follow-up shows her delivering a parcel at a cottage door; the other shows her sheltering beneath a giant mushroom with rain visible around it.
must_haves.why: The first visible picture shows her holding a parcel on a cottage doorstep; the second places her beneath a giant mushroom cap with clearly visible rainfall and puddles.

must_haves.item: Three separate square pictures share a consistent storybook illustration style and contain no text.
must_haves.why: The two supplied pictures are separate, square, text-free and stylistically consistent, but the third picture is not supplied.
